result.howAppartement: Up to three methods are combined: actual sales registered with notaries, asking prices corrected for the usual gap between asking and sale price, and rental yield. Then your living area, condition, energy class and extras adjust the price.
result.howMaison: There are no public sale prices for houses. The calculation starts from the average asking price of houses in your municipality, corrected for the usual gap between asking and sale price. Then your living area, condition, energy class, plot and extras adjust the price.
result.next1: Your request comes straight to me, and I’ll get back to you.
result.next2: On site, I fine-tune it with what figures can’t show: view, light, finishes.
result.statGap: The estimate applies a {p} reduction to asking prices.

facts.title: Did you know?
facts.step1: The Housing Observatory publishes a municipal average when at least 10 apartment sales are included in the analysis.
facts.energie: To improve a home’s energy rating, approved banks offer a state-guaranteed “climate loan” (prêt climatique).
facts.surface: Living area includes living spaces, bathrooms and toilets, and indoor circulation areas such as hallways.
facts.step4: The Housing Observatory also publishes apartment prices per m² with the value of garages, outdoor parking and cellars removed.
facts.step5: Asking rent statistics show what landlords request before negotiation.

coach.start: Hello, I’m Jason. A few questions, and I’ll give you a price range.
coach.step2: A rough floor area is fine to start with.
coach.step3: Not sure about an item? Pick “?” and we’ll go through it together.
coach.step4: Garage, cellar, terrace: the little extras count towards the price too.
coach.step5: Knowing your plans helps me call you back at the right time.
coach.step6: I’ll only use your number to talk about your property. Promise.
coach.maison: A house, great: I’ll look at the plot as well.
coach.energieGood: Rating {c}: a real plus these days.
coach.energieBad: Rating {c}, noted. Renovation work could make a difference.
coach.energieUnknown: No energy certificate to hand? I’ll carry on without it.
coach.allGood: I’ve set everything to “Good”. Change anything that doesn’t fit.
coach.bad: Thanks, that’s useful to know now.
coach.garage: A garage? Great, that counts towards the price.
coach.jardin: A private garden? Lovely, I’ll take that into account.
coach.cave: A cellar too? Great, I’ll add it.
coach.vendre: Selling? I can help you from start to finish.
coach.louer: Renting it out? I also offer property management.
coach.renseigne: Good idea to look into it first, with no commitment.
coach.nonProprio: No problem, I can also value a property you don’t own.
